description: Three-agent debug war room on a Python package with a real defect: a reproducer writes a regression test that fails on the current code, a fixer (depends_on reproducer, cannot edit tests) fixes business_days_between per docs/contract.md, and a reviewer (PLAN, depends_on fixer) confirms and names the root cause; verify.py replays the test against a compressed pristine copy of the buggy source.

criteria: The reproducer wrote tests/test_regression.py with cases that fail on the pristine code and documented them as failing_input lines; the fixer corrected business_days_between to count Mon-Fri days over the inclusive range without touching any test; the reviewer approved with the root cause named - and nobody touched the gate, the contract or the pre-existing suite.
